title: Length of the transition-action list
statement: Let $k,n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\mathrm{tr}$ be a transition function assigning an action to each state, input read, and work-tape read pattern, and let $q$ be a state in $\{0,\ldots,n\}$. The list of transition actions at $q$, formed by listing the actions for each of the three possible input reads and all work-tape read patterns, has length $3^{k+1}$.
hypotheses_covered: Transition function tr with the stated input, work-read, state, and action types
